description: This file defines the ProxyServer class with methods for creating, canonicalizing, and retrieving proxy server details, including handling schemes, host, and port. It includes functions for parsing and validating proxy server information.

classes.name: ProxyServer
classes.description: Represents a proxy server with methods for creation, validation, and retrieval of host and port information.

methods.name: ProxyServer
methods.description: Constructor initializing scheme and host/port pair, with validation for special schemes.

methods.name: FromSchemeHostAndPort
methods.description: Static method to create a ProxyServer from scheme, host, and port string or optional port.

methods.name: GetHost
methods.description: Returns the host part of the proxy server as a string.

methods.name: GetPort
methods.description: Returns the port number of the proxy server.

methods.name: host_port_pair
methods.description: Returns the host and port pair associated with the proxy server.

methods.name: GetDefaultPortForScheme
methods.description: Returns the default port number for a given scheme.
